calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --worktree
mu task claim t1 -w eval --for w1
mu task claim t2 -w eval --for w2
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do t1 and close it'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do t2 and close it'
mu agent wait w1 w2 -w eval --timeout 120
mu task close t1 -w eval --evidence 'worker died, closed it myself'
git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path w2 -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w2) rev-parse HEAD)
